messages:
Maya: quick status — aiming eu-edge go-live Thu EOD. Need final ownerships for KMS, routing, telemetry, and authz. Any blockers?
Sam H: I'm owner for routing policy + prefixes. I'll push the route-policy PR today. CC @Leo for CDN rules.
Leo: got it. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482. Needs review. Change is nginx upstream + healthcheck path.
Anika: security check: we need a customer-managed KMS key in eu-west-1 and audit log retention set to 13 months. I can provision but need ticket with project id.
Maya: project id is redwood-eu-edge-42. @Anika can you confirm steps and if we need a service account?
Anika: yes — need svc-account `infra-eu-edge-kms`. Also add these infra vars:
  kms_key_project: redwood-eu-edge-42
  kms_key_name: projects/redwood-eu-edge-42/locations/global/keyRings/edge/cryptoKeys/eu-edge
Sam H: routing note — we'll route traffic to eu-edge via weighted policy. When capacity < 20% fallback to global-hosted. Added to PR.
Paul (ops): telemetry owner here. Need collector endpoint + DNS. Suggest telemetry.eu.redwood-inference.internal. Canary should emit span tag `region=eu-edge`.
Maya: ETA for telemetry DNS + collector?
Paul (ops): I can have DNS + collector by tomorrow 17:00 UTC. Will open SR and link it here.
Leo: on code reviews — @Sam H can you add me as reviewer on the route-policy PR? I'll try to get to it this afternoon.
Sam H: added you. Also pinging @Anika for KMS IAM bindings review.
OncallBot: [auto] Canary smoke tests passed in staging: eu-edge-staging-1. All checks green.
Anika: saw the canary results. I'll run a KMS audit after key is provisioned.
Maya: blockers: any outstanding compliance checklist items?
Anika: need data residency attestation doc signed by Legal. I've started a draft — tagging @Maya for review.
Maya: will review tonight.
Leo: small infra note — update nginx config to set `proxy_buffer_size` for large embeddings responses. I'll include this change in infra PR.
Sam H: deployment plan: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 6h with rollback on 5xx spike > 0.5%. OK?
Maya: sounds good. Add SLO alert thresholds to the runbook.
Paul (ops): done — runbook updated at /docs/runbooks/eu-edge-deploy.md
Maya: thanks all. I'll send calendar invite for a final go/no-go sync 24h before deploy. :thumbsup:
Leo: :thumbsup:
Sam H: :rocket:
Anika: :white_check_mark:
Paul (ops): :ok_hand:
